sources.entry: Ice - Menu bar manager for hiding icons and organizing layouts. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/jordanbaird/Ice) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]
Ice - Powerful menu bar manager for macOS

summary.one_liner: Ice is a macOS menu bar manager for hiding, showing, and rearranging menu bar items, with added appearance and hotkey options.
summary.what_it_does: Ice hides and shows menu bar items, including an "always-hidden" section that keeps some items out of view. Hidden items can be revealed by hovering over the menu bar, clicking an empty area of it, or scrolling or swiping in it, and they can be rehidden automatically. A drag-and-drop interface arranges individual menu bar items, and a search panel finds them. Hidden items can be shown in a separate bar, which the README suggests for MacBooks with a notch. The README also lists menu bar tinting, shadow, border, and custom shapes, plus hotkeys for toggling sections and application menus. Launch at login and automatic updates are listed as implemented.
use_cases: hide clutter from the macOS menu bar
find a menu bar item quickly
show hidden menu bar icons on a MacBook with a notch
set hotkeys for menu bar sections
how_to_run: Or download Ice.zip from the latest release and move the app into Applications
notable: Drag-and-drop arrangement of individual menu bar items
Search panel for menu bar items
Separate Ice Bar for hidden items on notched MacBooks
Menu bar tint, shadow, border, and custom shapes
caveats: Requires macOS 14 or later; no plans to support earlier versions.
Still in active development; several roadmap items such as menu bar profiles, item groups, and individual spacers are unchecked.
Menu bar item spacing is marked BETA.
